overview: Create encrypted, verifiable Restic snapshots in a local folder you choose.
capabilities: Back up chosen folders, verify data, and browse snapshots
Restore into a new collision-safe folder without exposing native paths
permissions: Read access to source folders chosen in the native picker
Write access to repository and restore folders chosen in the native picker
getting_started: Initialize the repository, choose source folders, and start a backup.
changelog: v0.4.0 - Moved backup work behind explicit folder and backup grants with Host-owned repository, credential, and restricted-process handling on macOS.
